name: manual_763088
claim: commit_clean_test.sh fails with verify_args[@]: unbound variable on macOS stock bash 3.2 when neither --allow-empty nor --amend is set. Fix in commit-clean.sh: guard empty verify_args before expanding the array under set -u; regression-tested by commit_clean_test.sh.

decisions.notes: Found 2026-07-30 while verifying scripts/git/commit_clean_test.sh after PT PR #300 fixes -- test failed locally with this exact unbound-variable error even though Cursor's own automated review of the same PR reported 'all passed' for the identical test file, confirming this is a bash-version-dependent flake (stock macOS bash 3.2 vs whatever newer bash Cursor's review environment used), not a regression from PR #300's changes. Not yet fixed -- filed as a known issue for whoever picks it up next.
